title: Momentum before strategy
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: Do you choose the energy you bring into a meeting?
Jose asked: do you have a choice in the way you interact with people, and in the way the conversation will go?
He said that he created trust and energy, momentum, and asked if it comes before business strategy.
Jose said there is no pressure at all: you can decide that you will no longer feel pressure in a meeting, and go in with a demeanor of positivity, optimism and utmost confidence.
He said that when you go in with comfort, you create a relief in the meeting: no defensive attack, no formality.
A student said that she begins the day with affirmations that even the most boring task can be better, and works out how to improve the experience.
Jose said that you want to do it in a good way, with good intentions, values and ethics, because there are people who fake this and can be manipulative.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write the energy you want to bring.
Write what you will decide before you enter.
Write what you will do if pressure appears.
Write the line you will not cross.

check.q: What did Jose say comes with trust and energy?
What did Jose say to do about pressure?
choices: Decide you will not feel it
People who fake this and manipulate

recap: Bring trust and energy. Decide on no pressure. Be honest about it.
